baseline: a5bd361 (0.3.8 rendering plus five reviewed Charm wording corrections)
policy: Frozen scan-only alignments and original wording. Font and width policies selected on the original 33 calibration cards and checked on 123 reused validation cards. Per-card exact-size optima are fitted to each scan and are diagnostic, not predictive scores or renderer defaults.
metric: Existing WASM TextObjective text-region composite; not whole-card structural accuracy or percentage of correct pixels.
decision: Retain released typography. Neither the alternate font nor shared width/leading changes materially improve validation. A shallow content-based size rule fails validation and introduces a 22.8-point text-region regression. Preserve per-card fits for later review and default-rule research instead of embedding printing-ID overrides.
limitations: The text objective excludes the bottom-most paper and the P/T plate. Exact-size trials satisfy whole-layout bounds and P/T exclusions, but this diagnostic is not a full-card replay.
The displayed candidate is a text-layer replay, not a released renderer or automatic recommendation.
Six rejected single-face scans and three split printings are outside the 156-card diagnostic.
The same validation cards have appeared in prior studies; this is repeated validation.
